items.title: Chico Freeman interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001
items.q: I have to tell you that’s a very similar story that happened to the Adderleys, Cannonball and Nat.

ctx.x: Yes I played trumpet first. And that sort of happened, I don’t know, the luck of the draw you might say. My dad was in the Navy. He served in the Navy. Actually he and Clark Terry were in the same band, the Navy Hellcats, and they went to Hawaii during the, you know. And down in our basement my dad had all of his Navy gear, and he had this little storage room down there. And my brother and I were down there as kids do, going through everything we could find. I was looking for anything — I found his bell bottoms,…

I have to tell you that’s a very similar story that happened to the Adderleys, Cannonball and Nat. Yeah, we could talk about that. Almost a similar thing happened. So did you get to use the horn in a professional setting at all, or was that post college?
